angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 1,342,701 km at 134.54 pc = 0.13 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 7.4327 +/- 0.0217 mas (same row, RUWE 1.02): 134.54 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.93 +/- 0.1 solar radii from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of KELT-2 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract): 1,342,701 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.54 +/- 0.28 solar masses from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of KELT-2 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 6327 +/- 80 K from Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-2 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Stassun et al. 2017, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of KELT-2 A b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/kelt-2-a.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.054, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-2 A (pscomppars): spectral type F8, from Cannon & Pickering 1918 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1918AnHar..91....1C/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-2 A (pscomppars): [Fe/H] 0 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-2 A (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.6889, from Gaia DR2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2018A&A...616A...1G/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-2 A (pscomppars): age 3.97 Gyr, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of KELT-2 A (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 9 km/s, from Bonomo et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017A&A...602A.107B/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
